features.nameAr: إضافة من 1 إلى 3 إيميلات تنبيه لكل موقع
features.nameEn: One to three notification recipients per site
features.notes: Owner-scoped site recipients support 1..3 enabled addresses, validation, case-insensitive deduplication, enable/disable and regression coverage. Release 155.140.0 adds provider-native missing-table upgrades for existing SQL Server/PostgreSQL/MySQL/MariaDB databases without replaying SQLite-shaped migrations; .NET Build Verification #1158 passed on the implementation slice before final release/status commits.

Implemented tenant-safe per-site SMTP profile, account-profile inheritance mode, encrypted password storage and UI. Non-SQLite missing-table upgrade support is delivered in 155.140.0; final runtime/provider verification remains.

Implemented account SMTP profile, up to three dashboard recipients, encrypted credentials, SQLite compatibility, account UI and site inheritance. Non-SQLite missing-table upgrade support is delivered in 155.140.0; final runtime/provider verification remains.

SMTP passwords use the existing secret-protection abstraction, remain write-only in UI, can be rotated or cleared, and are decrypted only for delivery/diagnostics. Awaiting final clean runtime verification.

features.nameAr: اختبار إعدادات البريد وإرسال رسالة تجريبية
features.notes: Implemented shared DNS/TCP diagnostics, sanitized TLS/auth/SMTP test-send reporting, account diagnostics UI, site diagnostics workspace, and test-profile separation from outbound-enabled state. Awaiting runtime verification against real SMTP providers.

Implemented application-level renderer abstraction, six stable bilingual template keys, RTL/LTR HTML and plain-text bodies, HTML encoding, subject newline sanitization, required-token validation, catalog metadata and regression tests. Automated build/test verification is green; final feature-level runtime reconciliation remains.

Implemented durable tenant-scoped site operational-report schedules with hourly/daily/weekly/monthly recurrence, timezone/DST-safe next-run calculation, Arabic/English template preference, persisted claim/retry state, atomic multi-instance claims, stale-claim recovery, site recipient resolution, outbox-only idempotent enqueue, bilingual /email/schedules UI, Site Settings navigation, migration and regression tests. Release 155.140.0 closes the existing non-SQLite missing-table upgrade gap; final runtime scheduling verification remains.

Implemented account-level dashboard digest schedules independent of site schedules, with hourly/daily/weekly/monthly recurrence, timezone/DST handling, Arabic/English output, dashboard recipient resolution, durable outbox enqueue with occurrence-based idempotency, scheduler retries, unified /email/schedules UI and Account Email Settings navigation. Awaiting final runtime verification before completion.

features.nameEn: Email outbox, retries, idempotency, and correlation
features.notes: Implemented durable outbox entities, owner-scoped idempotency, recipient/message snapshots, persisted delivery scope, atomic conditional claims, exponential retry/backoff, stale-claim restart recovery, sanitized attempt history, DI registration, active background SMTP worker and regression tests. Release 155.140.0 adds provider-native missing-table upgrades plus legacy Scope backfill for non-SQLite databases; real-provider runtime delivery verification remains.

Implemented tenant-safe account/site delivery history service and bilingual /email/history workspace with site/status/correlation filters, message metadata, retry attempt history, idempotency/correlation identifiers, sanitized failure diagnostics, Site Settings navigation, global Operations navigation/quick-search entry and regression tests for tenant isolation and filtering. Awaiting final runtime verification before completion.

Operational alert coverage now includes three durable sources: WordPress synchronization failures, execution-job failures, and high-signal Security.Audit.v1 events. All three reuse the durable IEmailOutbox path with deterministic source-event idempotency/correlation, scoped recipient resolution, bounded restart recovery, per-candidate failure isolation, and sanitized message boundaries. The security slice alerts blocked authentication, password reset/change, account disablement, role/grant changes, session revocations, and security-sensitive AI provider settings while excluding ordinary failed-password noise and preventing cross-owner recipient fallback. Automated Build, .NET Build Verification, UX Regression Gate, and PR Plan Link passed for the security implementation before this reconciliation. EML-011 remains in_progress only for future subscription/billing event alerts, which stay out of scope until the billing phase is implemented.

features.nameEn: Email rate limits, duplicate suppression, and retention
features.notes: Configurable per-account limits and cleanup policy. REL-006 is not currently present in the development-status registry, so this feature remains dependency-blocked rather than being started by assumption.

Release 155.143.0 delivers the provider-neutral subscription plan catalog: immutable normalized plan code, bilingual names/descriptions, Monthly/Yearly interval, bounded price and three-letter currency, trial/grace policy, enabled state, deterministic sort order, optional opaque gateway mapping, application catalog abstraction, EF persistence with case-insensitive DB uniqueness and duplicate-race handling, SQLite migration, non-SQLite provider-native missing-table compatibility, DI registration, and focused automated tests. No PayPal dependency, entitlement keys, subscription state, commercial seed plans, or invented pricing are included. The implementation cycle passed .NET Build Verification before this canonical reconciliation; the exact final head must pass all required PR gates again before merge.

Release 155.144.0 delivers typed plan entitlements using stable keys rather than plan-name checks. The implementation includes the nine approved initial definitions, invariant Boolean/Integer/Decimal/String value handling, non-negative constraints for initial max/retention definitions, durable per-plan unique key persistence, explicit missing-resolution semantics, reusable Boolean capability and integer-limit evaluation, plan isolation, FK cascade, SQLite migration, provider-native non-SQLite missing-table compatibility, DI registration, and focused automated coverage. Missing entitlements do not grant capability or invent limits. No PayPal dependency, account subscription binding, product-module enforcement, usage counters, unlimited sentinel, or seeded commercial entitlement values are introduced. The implementation cycle passed .NET Build Verification before this canonical reconciliation; the exact final head must pass all required PR gates again before merge.

Release 155.145.0 delivers the provider-neutral current account subscription authority with Trialing/Active/PastDue/Grace/Suspended/Cancelled/Expired states, terminal Expired semantics, one durable row per account, internal PlanId linkage, validated UTC lifecycle ranges, cancel/grace/suspend/cancel/expiry timestamps, optional opaque provider binding, monotonic provider-event watermark, centralized transition legality, stale-provider-event rejection before mutation, and durable transition audit rows committed atomically with real state changes. Same-state confirmations do not create fake audit history. SQLite migration, provider-native non-SQLite compatibility, DI registration and regression tests cover uniqueness, audit atomicity, stale events, invalid-transition mutation safety, grace rules and lifecycle updates. No gateway-specific logic, policy scheduler, checkout/webhook sync, plan changes or product enforcement are introduced. The implementation cycle passed .NET Build Verification before this canonical reconciliation; the exact final head must pass all required PR gates again before merge.

features.nameEn: Trial, grace-period, suspension, and expiry policies
features.notes: Release 155.146.0 delivers deterministic provider-neutral lifecycle policy for trial expiry, plan-configured past-due grace, grace expiry, suspension, cancelled/current-period expiry and cancel-at-period-end. Automatic transitions never infer Active, never call a payment gateway, never delete account/site/content data, and always flow through the audited BIL-003 transition service. The bounded worker selects only due candidates so healthy/suspended rows cannot starve later work. Persisted lifecycle timestamps are normalized to UTC at the persistence boundary because SQLite materialization can return DateTimeKind.Unspecified while domain validation remains strict. Automated policy, audit, idempotency, batch-fairness and data-preservation tests passed .NET Build Verification before this canonical reconciliation; the exact final head must pass all required PR gates again before merge.
Current plan, renewal, status, limits, usage, upgrade/downgrade/cancel and history.
Business logic must not depend directly on PayPal.
Sandbox/live configuration, encrypted client credentials, validation diagnostics.
Checkout is server-created; browser return is navigation only and never proof of payment.
Verify authenticity, store unique gateway event IDs, process replay safely.
